---
name: Voice provider request / Demande de fournisseur vocal
about: Suggest an additional voice API; integration depends on feasibility and testing.
title: "[Provider request] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

Only OpenAI is currently supported. A request is not a promise of integration or a delivery date.
Seule l’API OpenAI est actuellement prise en charge. Une demande ne garantit ni ajout ni délai.

**Provider and model / Fournisseur et modèle**

**Public API documentation link / Lien vers la documentation API publique**

**Intended use and languages / Usage souhaité et langues**

**Why this provider? / Pourquoi ce fournisseur ?**
For example: language coverage, latency, cost, voice quality. Link evidence if available; estimates are not measured results.

**Optional: can you help test or contribute? / Facultatif : pouvez-vous tester ou contribuer ?**
If relevant, give phone model and Android version only. Do not include serial numbers.

**Privacy / Confidentialité**
Do not include API keys, credentials, account screenshots, contacts, phone numbers, private conversations or recordings. Public documentation URLs must not contain access tokens.
Ne publiez aucune clé API, identifiant, capture de compte, contact, numéro, conversation privée ou enregistrement.
